notes_for_referee:
Real-data acceptance (do NOT run on worker machine for days):

1) Prerequisites: install qlib extra + csi300 data pack under ~/.qlib/qlib_data/cn_data (or pass --data-dir). From repo root:
   python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -e ".[dev,demo,qlib]"
   Ensure the chenditc investment_data pack for tag 2026-07-05 is present (killer_demo ensure_data_pack / --skip-download after first download).

2) Calibrate (freeze β* first) — expected runtime: minutes on real data:
   .venv/bin/python -m examples.power_calibration.calibrate --out examples/power_calibration/out

3) Full power sweep — expected runtime: ~1.5–2 days serial at R0=40; worst case ~4.2 days at R=120 adaptive cap:
   .venv/bin/python -m examples.power_calibration --out examples/power_calibration/out --calibration examples/power_calibration/out/calibration.json

Artifacts: run_config.json (frozen seeds/β*/φ), results.json, report.md, figure.png/svg, beta_t_appendix.json, per-seed ledgers under out/ledgers/. Do not write realized ICIR back onto the strength axis. Power is uncertified (direct court).
